description: Frozen 16-case benchmark evaluation dataset spanning animation, documentary, short film, crowdfunding, ambiguous titles, sparse sources, and conflicting reports.

cases.title: Junichiro Jackson
verifiedFacts: Proof-of-concept animation directed by Chaz Bottoms (CBC Studios) in co-production with TeamTO.
Set in an anime-inspired futuristic Chicago scored to Chicago hip-hop.
Seeking series financing for a half-hour episodic format.
conflictsOrNegations: Setting is Chicago, disproving hallucinated near-future Brooklyn claims.

cases.title: CYCLE
cases.verifiedSubject: Ty'Rese West fatal police shooting in Mount Pleasant, WI
cases.disprovedLore: Youth bicycle collective rebuilding discarded bikes
verifiedFacts: Directed by Laura Dyan Kezman and produced by Lion Art Media.
Investigative documentary covering the fatal police shooting of 18-year-old Ty'Rese West in Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin.
Covered by Milwaukee Journal Sentinel, Racine County Eye, WUWM 89.7, and PBS Wisconsin.
conflictsOrNegations: Zero bicycle collective lore; strictly investigative civil rights documentary.

cases.title: The Vampair Series
verifiedFacts: Independent gothic musical animation franchise created by Daria Cohen.
Crowdfunded $286,400 across Kickstarter and Indiegogo specifically for an 11-minute musical pilot.
Daria Cohen retains 100% intellectual property ownership.
conflictsOrNegations: $286k pilot campaign funding is distinct from $1.5M-$2.0M full episodic series budget.

cases.title: American Pachuco
verifiedFacts: Documentary chronicling Luis Valdez, El Teatro Campesino, and the United Farm Workers movement.
Features restored 16mm archival footage from 1968 agricultural strikes.
materialUnknowns: PBS Independent Lens national carriage clearance

cases.title: Signal in the Pines
verifiedFacts: 14-minute analog sci-fi short filmed entirely on 16mm celluloid in the Pacific Northwest.
Won Best Sound Design at Northwest Film Forum 2025.

cases.title: River of Copper
verifiedFacts: Investigative documentary documenting illegal copper runoff in eastern Kentucky watersheds.
Funded via Kickstarter with $49,200 raised from 612 backers.

cases.title: Icarus Rising
verifiedFacts: Student animated short by Maya Lin exploring digital isolation.
Completely unrelated to the 2017 Bryan Fogel Oscar-winning documentary Icarus.
conflictsOrNegations: Must not conflate with Netflix/Bryan Fogel Olympic doping documentary.

cases.title: The Bear
verifiedFacts: Independent stop-motion short film by Liam Kelly following a polar bear in a melting habitat.
Not affiliated with the FX/Hulu culinary drama television series The Bear.
conflictsOrNegations: Must not link to FX on Hulu or Jeremy Allen White.

cases.title: Echoes in the Chalk
verifiedFacts: Experimental 8-minute short selected for Cornwall Film Festival 2025.
Only 1 verifiable primary web citation exists.
conflictsOrNegations: Must abstain from demographic, budget, or theatrical audience claims due to source sparsity.

cases.title: Cyber-Ronin
verifiedFacts: Independent CGI proof of concept created by Kenji Sato.
Creator publicly clarified on Twitter/X that rumored acquisition by Sony Pictures is false.
conflictsOrNegations: Studio acquisition rumor was explicitly denied by creator; rights remain 100% independent.

cases.title: Lackadaisy
verifiedFacts: Animated web series based on Tracy Butler's webcomic.
Crowdfunded over $2,000,000 on BackerKit for Season 1 production.

cases.title: Scavengers Reign
verifiedFacts: Adult animated sci-fi series originally premiered on Max.
Cancelled by Max after season 1; licensed non-exclusively to Netflix in 2024.
conflictsOrNegations: Netflix holds streaming license but has not officially greenlit Season 2.

cases.title: Sonder
verifiedFacts: 13-minute 3D computer-animated short made using Unity game engine for real-time rendering.
Premiered at festivals; no commercial feature deal signed.

cases.title: Racine River Blues
verifiedFacts: Regional short documentary on southeastern Wisconsin blues musicians.
Screened at Racine Heritage Museum and local library circuit.
conflictsOrNegations: Hyper-local community impact screening model with zero commercial theatrical release.

cases.title: The Last Horizon
verifiedFacts: Independent VFX test by Tarek Mansour.
Fan nominator claimed James Cameron was executive producing; public records verify no Cameron attachment.
conflictsOrNegations: Nominator claim of James Cameron attachment is completely unverified and contradicted by crew listings.

cases.title: Neon Drift
verifiedFacts: Stylized synthwave racing proof of concept.
Seeking series packaging representation; no streaming platform distribution.
